summary: Attempt 1's source, hook and case work built clean and was kept after review and a full run. I added what was missing: the StopTarget corpus and test (O-015), the in-place fitness text fix (O-037), a tree-then-Folders step and a completed-run open in the cases, the design record, and removed two unread constants. After Stop the window still opens on the list, and a 'Folder tree' choice beside it shows the stopped store. A folder the store marks not listed reads 'not read yet' with no figures, bar or expander, through one HasFigures gate and one shared word. Full suite 1023/1023; T-010, T-011, T-012, R-004 (run unattended per Q-275), T-006, L-001, L-002 and T-001 pass, and WindowMutants (12 of 12), RuleCases and the rules harness (167/167) pass. T-003 fails on its 'taller window' VOID check, as it does at HEAD on this display.

obligations.how: T-010 run 1: p00-p04 (never listed, depth 1) draw 'not read yet', blank on-disk/size/share, hidden bar, no expander, storeNotListed true. Passed.
T-010 run 1: 195 of m-mid's subfolders (depth 2 under a listed folder) draw 'not read yet' with no figures; m-mid itself keeps its own figures. Passed.
T-010 asserts the store's own NotListed count (store-marks, 200) equals the walked not-listed rows (200), read through LastResult.Store independently of the rows. Passed.
T-010 run 1: a-empty (depth 1) and b-listed\empty (depth 2) read note '', '0 bytes', no expander, storeNotListed false. Passed.
T-010 run 1: m-mid (listed, with listed d000-d00x and unread children) has note '', its figures and an expander. Passed.
T-010 run 1: b-listed\denied reads 'could not be opened', no expander, and the panel names it and no not-listed folder; no not-listed row carries a KindText word. Passed.

T-010 compares each stopped-list row with the same-named depth-1 tree row: NotRead exactly when the store marks it, title '<name>  (<tree note>)'; states Done/StoppedPartway/NotRead seen at once. Passed; SL-063 DoneRowFinality (10 Facts) also passes.
T-010 run 1 now runs VIEWS kinds,folders,tree,folders,tree: after the tree, Folders restores the list with the stopped header and all 9 titles byte-identical (5 read '(not read yet)'). Passed.
T-011: Stop at j-before (exact), pressedAt == j-before, m-big storeNotListed true with childCount 0; its row reads 'not read yet', no figure/bar/expander; panel empty. Passed first launch.
T-012: Stop at m-big\; m-big listed with 100,000 children, 9,994 not listed; five opens 66.8, 2.1, 1.7, 1.5, 1.7 ms (limit 500). Passed.
T-010 CAN_REVEAL=p04 (the design's p04, not p19): selected and focused, canExecute true, pathOf == the store's GetPath for the entry. Passed.
StoppedTreeOfferTests sweeps the Stop before and during every guarded call: empty-store, not-listed-root and listed-root shapes all reached, OffersStoppedTree matches the store at each. Passed.

T-010 run 2 scans the same tree to the end: no choice offered, kinds-and-back leaves the tree, no row marked or saying 'not read yet', every row draws figures; T-012's completed run opens m-big with 0 not-listed rows. Passed.

StopTarget.Matches takes the target or anything under it when the target ends in a backslash; T-010 uses m-mid\, T-012 m-big\, R-004 n-slow\, exact only for T-011's j-before. The class is enumerated in StopTargetCorpus.json (30 rows plus exactAllowed); StopTargetTests feeds every row and censuses the cases' targets. With IsSubtree forced false (the exact-only matcher) 21 tests failed; restored, all pass.

mutation.find: internal static bool IsSubtree(string target) => target.EndsWith('\\');
mutation.replace: internal static bool IsSubtree(string target) => false;

obligations.how: R-004's fixture has n-slow (3,000 subfolders of one file) between the stop target n-slow\ and z-unread, and is void unless z-unread reads storeNotListed true and 'not read yet'. Passed unattended (Q-275): status line '', LastRevealOutcome Exact, Explorer selection read as z-unread; only its own windows closed. With n-slow emptied the case went red (3 VOID launches).

OnResultsViewChanged returns before the tree/list swap unless ShowTreeButton is visible. T-010 run 2 chooses File kinds then Folders at a completed ending and finds the tree shown with one item and the same header. With the gate removed T-010 went red.

Timed at HEAD in a scratch copy with a cold publish and hook build: T-003 62.7 s; T-006 here 30.7 s cold. Built cases: T-010 13-14 s, T-011 60 s (28 s fixture), T-012 61-63 s (with the completed run), R-004 9-10 s. T-011 and T-012 are separate cases with their own fixtures; each run is at most 3 launches. All are under 120 s.
obligations.not_mutable: The fix is a measurement and a split of one case into two with their own fixtures; no test observes it except the engine's 120 s limit itself, which only a slower machine would trip.

obligations.how: StoppedTree.Spin busy-waits on a volatile read of ScanProgress's raw _currentFolder (no Thread.Sleep in the poll) and logs pollMeanNs (about 18 ns) and worstGapMs (about 6 ms) on every tree-stop line.

The tree header leads with 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before.' T-010 logs headerCharsShown/headerWidth at 880 px (109 of 201 characters) and at the 560 px minimum (48), and checks the lead and the word survive the ellipsis.
Same shape as O-002 (depth 1 p00-p04 and depth 2 under m-mid): T-010 run 1. Passed.
Same as O-013: StoppedTreeOfferTests (Stop before the root is appended, in the root's listing, after it). Passed.
Same as O-005: T-010 run 1 a-empty and b-listed\empty. Passed.
Same as O-008: T-010 list-versus-tree comparison from one constant; SL-063 Fact pins the title text. Both pass.
Same as O-010: T-011 (pressedAt == j-before, m-big cut). Passed.
Same as O-007: T-010 denied folder beside unread folders. Passed.
Same as O-011: T-012 stopped open, five opens all under 500 ms. Passed.

T-012's completed run (same 100,000-child m-board fixture scanned to the end): notListedChildren 0, opens 73.2, 2.2, 2.1, 1.6, 1.8 ms. T-003 itself fails on this PC at HEAD and here alike on its 'taller window' VOID check (241.9 px against 241.9 px); its five opens pass in both (96 ms at HEAD, 100 ms here), so T-012 carries the discharge.
Same as O-012: T-010 CAN_REVEAL=p04 (canExecute true, path equals the store's). Passed.
R-004 passed unattended per Q-275: tree:z-unread revealed through the row's menu, status line '', LastRevealOutcome Exact, Explorer showing the root with z-unread as the only selection.
T-010 run 2 (completed scan, kinds then Folders, no choice, no 'not read yet'); T-001 also passes.
T-006, L-001, L-002 and T-001 pass unchanged (the stopped ending still opens on the list); SL-100 (29) and SL-063 (10) pass; WindowMutants -Mutant All passed 12 of 12 (446 s).

T-010 run 3: stop, choose the tree, select p04, start a second scan: the choice is hidden and Folders checked, the stopped store was collected twice, the second tree shows its own rows with no unread row. Passed.

Run 3 sets FSA_HOOK_SELECT=p04; TreeMode gained AfterRelease, which logs treeChoice, foldersChecked, treeChecked and the second store's marks and walks the second tree one level. Every promised check has a log line behind it.

Every new store read in the hook goes through NoInlining helpers in StoppedTree.cs (StoreMarks, NotListedOf, NotListedChildren, StorePathOf) that resolve LastResult.Store on each call and return values only; the file's remarks say no hook field, cached delegate or closure may hold the store. T-010 run 3 confirms the store is collected twice.

Edited the existing fitness.yaml entry in place: it now names the actual headers ('Rows marked not read yet or stopped partway are short.' and 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before…') and says both are built from TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet. In code, ListHeader and StoppedTreeHeader build their words from the constant. The rules harness is 167/167 AS-RECORDED and RuleCases C-001/C-003 pass.

deviations: Attempt 1's uncommitted work was kept, not reverted: the solution built clean, and after review its source matched the design. It was then verified by running everything. Only the missing parts were added.

T-011 (cut) and T-012 (100k open) are separate cases from the start, each with its own fixture (c-prefix 5,000 against 3,000). The design allowed a split only if the projection ran over 120 s. Measured 60 s and 61-63 s, so each is independent and under the limit.

T-012 gained a second run: the same m-big fixture scanned to the end, opened five times, with 0 not-listed rows. The design pointed the completed-tree open at T-003, which fails on this PC at HEAD on an environmental VOID check, so it could not discharge C-023.

T-010 run 1 now sets VIEWS to kinds,folders,tree,folders,tree (the design had kinds,folders,tree) so that tree-then-Folders is exercised, and the view lines carry listTitles to compare the list byte for byte.
Review m1 changed the design's 'existing Release step with no change': run 3 sets FSA_HOOK_SELECT=p04 and TreeMode gained an AfterRelease step that runs after Release when the run was stopped.
The StopTarget words are in their own file (StopTarget.cs, no WPF) and compiled into Core.Tests, so the O-015 corpus runs in the default suite; the design had no such file.
No workaround for an outside defect is involved, so there is no KnownWorkarounds entry and no switch.
not_built: Q-071's per-pass containment of the on-demand tree build (review m3, deferred by decision).
Widening rule 2's pattern or calling it a tripwire in its text (O-038, waived to SC-388).
A subtree-unfinished mark; a distinct word for a folder Stop cut inside its listing (U-189 says a Core change); both filed in the design record.
Any claim about Stop on a stalled share or the SMB/TEST-NET-1 network pass (Q-274: still owed by a person).
A 5M-entry stopped-store memory measurement with the tree open (Q-270 is still open).
follow_ups: T-003's 'taller window' VOID check fails on any display whose default window already fills the work area (this one: 241.9 px against 241.9 px, identical at HEAD). It should skip that check in that case instead of failing.

When the engine puts a mutated file back, it should write it with a fresh modification time: restoring the original mtime made dotnet reuse the DLL built from the mutated source. I hit this restoring StopTarget.cs by hand and fixed it by touching the file.
After SL-110 merges, run R-004 again as Q-275 asks and record the status line, LastRevealOutcome and Explorer's selection (this build's run: '', Exact, selection z-unread).
Q-270 (stopped 5M-entry store plus the stopped tree on a 100k-child folder, under 1 GiB) is still unmeasured; the scratch-hook route (#482) applies.
The network pass (Q-274, lesson #136) is still owed by a person: this slice touched MainWindow*, FsaWindowHook and WindowCases.ps1 again.
